back_translation: Then he brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east, but it was shut.

And the LORD said to me, 'This gate shall remain shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it; therefore it must remain shut.
Only the prince may sit inside it to eat food before the LORD; he must enter by way of the portico of the gate and go out the same way.'
Then he brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate. I looked, and behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD, and I fell facedown to the ground.

The LORD said to me, 'Son of man, pay attention; look with your eyes and listen with your ears to everything I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD. Take careful note of the entrance to the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.
Say to the rebellious house of Israel, Thus says the Lord GOD: O house of Israel, enough of all your abominations!

In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into My sanctuary, defiling My house, when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; so you broke My covenant by all your abominations.
And you did not keep charge of My holy things, but appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you.
Thus says the Lord GOD: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh shall enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.
But the Levites who wandered far from Me when Israel went astray, who wandered from Me after their idols, must bear the consequences of their iniquity.

Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, keeping charge of the gates of the temple and ministering in the temple; they shall slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people and stand to serve them.

Because they ministered to the people before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I lifted My hand in an oath that they must bear the consequences of their iniquity, declares the Lord GOD.
They shall not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near any of My holy things or the most holy things; they must bear the shame of the abominations they committed.
Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work of the temple and everything that must be done in it.

But the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, shall approach Me to minister to Me; they shall stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.
They alone shall enter My sanctuary and draw near to My table to minister to Me; they shall keep My charge.
When they enter the gates of the inner court, they must wear linen garments; they shall not wear wool while they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.
They shall wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists; they must not wear anything that makes them sweat.

When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they must take off the garments in which they ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and put on other clothes, so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.
They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but must trim their hair neatly.
No priest may drink wine before he enters the inner court.
They must not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but may marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.
They must teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.
In any dispute they shall act as judges and judge according to My ordinances; they shall keep My laws and statutes at all My appointed feasts, and keep My Sabbaths holy.
A priest must not go near a dead person and become unclean, except for a father, mother, son, daughter, brother, or unmarried sister; for these he may make himself unclean.
After he is cleansed, he must count seven days for himself.
And on the day he enters the holy place, into the inner court, to minister in the holy place, he must present his sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.
As for their inheritance, I Myself am their inheritance; you shall give them no possession of land in Israel, for I Myself am their possession.
They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, and everything in Israel devoted to the LORD shall be theirs.

The best of all the firstfruits and every contribution from all your offerings shall belong to the priests. You shall give the first of your dough to the priest, so that a blessing may rest on your homes.
The priests must not eat any bird or animal that died of itself or was torn by wild beasts.
